title: FIERCE Bent Glass Mouthpiece
description:
FIERCE Bent Glass Mouthpiece
The Fierce glass mouthpiece enables a complete glass vapour path. When using these stems herb is loaded into the glass stem instead of directly into the Fierce vaporizer.
Included
1 x FIERCE Bent Glass Mouthpiece
